title.narrative: ISO1.3Status of Angolas trade policy on the regional and global perspectives

description.narrative: ISO1.3Status of Angolas trade policy on the regional and global perspectives

comment.narrative: Precise statement BSO1.3 2016 Trade policy concept and implementation measures managed under the traditional framework

Precise statement TSO1.3 2021 Trade policy and trade negotiation approaches reviewed and updated based on support of the EUfunded intervention in the light of ongoing regional processesobjective include modern approaches to a significant extent

Important changes are being undertaken with UNCTAD assistance. In line with UNCTADs recommendations a multisectorial Trade Negotiations Commission with private sector participation is being set up. With UNCTADs support an impact evaluation of Angolas accession to the EUSADC EPA was carried out to move towards informed trade policy making. The core negotiations team has been capacitated through various trainings by UNCTAD and consequently a process of reforming Angolas trade policy has been launched. It is awaited that by the end of the programme these key processes will be concluded which would mean significant improvements.

It is awaited that by the end of the programme these key processes will be concluded which would mean significant improvements.
